content.short: FBTC is a decentralized, fully-collateralized wrapped Bitcoin maintaining a strict 1:1 peg with BTC for use across DeFi ecosystems.
content.description: FBTC is a wrapped Bitcoin asset designed to bring BTC's capital into DeFi without compromising its core security properties. The token maintains a strict 1:1 peg with Bitcoin backed by decentralized custodial infrastructure, enabling Bitcoin holders to participate in DeFi protocols on Mantle and other EVM-compatible chains. FBTC is built to be the standard composable BTC primitive in the multi-chain DeFi landscape, supporting lending, borrowing, and yield strategies while remaining redeemable 1:1 for native BTC at all times.
content.meta: FBTC is a decentralized 1:1 Bitcoin-pegged asset enabling BTC holders to participate in Mantle DeFi. Discover FBTC on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
